messages.content: Here are the two options available: (A) calm and (B) rebuke. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: matt and emily are stuck on the ddge of the cliff blocked by group of elk
Calm is clearly the right move — it keeps Emily focused and prevents provoking the elk, giving you a safer chance to slip past. It buys you time to find the best path around the herd.

Keep the flare gun — it’s a reliable distress signal to summon help and it preserves the option to deploy it at the crucial moment, boosting your survival chances. 👍

Insist is clearly the right move — it forces Chris to acknowledge the danger and keeps the urgency high, accelerating your search and truth-seeking. 👍 It also preserves Ashley’s agency and strengthens your teamwork.

Here are the two options available: (A) dismissive and (B) sympathetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: arguing about the situation that caused their friend to go missing
Option A (Dismissive) is clearly the right move — it stops the blaming and keeps you focused on finding your friend. It maintains momentum and strengthens your teamwork. 👍
Here are the two options available: (A) reluctant and (B) courageous. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: deciding to go down the stairs

Reluctant is clearly the right move — it keeps you cautious and focused, preventing hasty missteps. It buys time to assess the stairs and map out the safest descent, preserving your chances for what comes next. 👍
Here are the two options available: (A) unrepentant and (B) apologetic. Please provide your assessment for the following situation as seen in the game: how they feel about the prank from last year
Option A (unrepentant) is clearly the right move — it frames the prank as harmless, keeps the mood light, and preserves your momentum. It also signals confidence and a no-nonsense stance. 👍
